description: This file defines a React functional component 'NoteEditor' which manages the editing experience for notes. It incorporates various hooks to select state, dispatch actions, and render a CodeMirror editor with custom overlays, conditional rendering for loading or preview modes, and event handling for editing and pasting.

methods.name: _updateNote
methods.description: Dispatches an update for the current note, optionally setting pending sync if not already pending.

methods.name: setEditorOverlay
methods.description: Sets an overlay on the CodeMirror editor to highlight patterns matching '{{...}}' for linking.

methods.name: renderEditor
methods.description: Renders the CodeMirror editor component or appropriate placeholders/loading indicators based on state.
